newsitem.title: USA: Standard Motor, ATS in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Standard Motor, ATS in joint venture.

text.p: Standard Motor Products Inc and ATS Automation Tooling Systems Inc said Friday they have formed a new company to manufacture and sell advanced technical products for use in automotive vehicles both as original equipment and for aftermarket applications.
The new corporation, Centaur Thermal Systems Inc, is owned equally by both companies and will be based in Cambridge, Ontario, Canada. The Heat Battery will be the first product to be manufactured.

The battery, said the companies, captures and stores engine heat and uses this energy upon subsequent engine starts to rapidly warm the cabin, reduce windshield defrost time, and significantly reduce critical cold start engine emissions.
Centaur, said the companies, is currently preparing to commence production and shipment of Heat Batteries in mid 1997 to European automotive manufacturers, initially for aftermarket installations.
The battery, they said, is also in advanced stages of testing at several North American and European automotive companies for use as original equipment.
